title: 3.1 Task Definition
use_cases: Use when decomposing complex script generation into structured sequential stages
Implement when constructing initial event backbones and character relations for narratives
Configure when an iterative evaluation and refining cycle is required to optimize narrative graphs
Use when transforming structured graph data into coherent natural language scripts
content: Given a concise premise PP, our goal is to generate a complete, high-quality script SS. We propose a framework ℱ\mathcal{F} that decomposes this complex generation task into three consecutive stages: (1) Graph-based Narrative Planning, which constructs the initial event backbone and character relation; (2) Iterative Graph Refinement, which optimizes the narrative (event and character) graph through an iterative Evaluate-Plan-Revise cycle; and (3) Graph-Grounded Script Synthesis, which transforms the structured graph into a natural language script. The overall framework is illustrated in Figure 1.
